name: 19_pause_while_late
description: A hardship pause approved while the series is already Late: the status reads Paused but is_late_underlying keeps treasury releases blocked until the overdue payment is made; the Q1 countdown stops during the pause (4 late days → 4 days of accrual when paid on 1 June), releases resume right after payment, and Q2's clock (starting 1 July, after the pause) is unshifted: InGrace one second after 31 July.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: 2,000 due by 1 May, grace to 16 May
Late since 16 May 00:00:01; tranche 2 (vested 8 April) was never claimed
pause 20 May → 20 June approved while Late (4 late days so far)
status Paused (derived), pauseCount 1, pausedTotal 31 d; 2,000 still due
Paused does not lift the release block: is_late_underlying ignores the pause
still blocked eight days into the pause
countdown(Q1) = 61 d − 12 d paused = 49 d; late days = 49 − 45 = 4 → accrual = mulDiv(mulDiv(2,000e6, 0.08e18, 1e18), 4, 365) = 1,753,424
Q1 paid with 4 days of accrual; still Paused until 20 June; is_late_underlying false
releases resume as soon as the arrears are paid, pause or not: tranche 2
OnTime: Q2's countdown has not started (period ends 1 July)
31 July: Q2 countdown 30 d → OnTime (the pause ended before Q2's clock started, so nothing shifts)
one second later: InGrace — the Q2 deadline is the unshifted 31 July
